title: A Phone Call to Apologize to a Parent
script: Yusuf: [regretfully] Dad, I wanted to call and talk about yesterday. I was rude to you at dinner, and I've felt bad about it since.
Father: [calmly] I noticed you were upset. What happened, exactly?
Yusuf: I was tired from work, and I raised my voice when you asked about my plans. I shouldn't have spoken to you that way.
Father: I appreciate you calling to say that. It takes courage to admit something like this.
Yusuf: I know respect toward parents matters a lot, and I ignored that completely in that moment.
Father: Everyone loses patience sometimes, son. What matters more is what you do after.
Yusuf: Still, I keep thinking about your face when I raised my voice. I hurt you, and I'm truly sorry.
Father: [warmly] I forgive you, Yusuf. Truly. I was young once too, and I made similar mistakes with my own father.
Yusuf: Thank you, Dad. That means more to me than you know.
Father: Just remember, next time you feel that frustration rising, take a breath before you speak.
Yusuf: [determined] I will try. I don't want tiredness to become an excuse for disrespect again.
Father: That's a wise thing to notice at your age. Not everyone learns that lesson so early.
Yusuf: I learned it from watching you, actually. You always stayed calm with your own parents, even when tired.
Father: I'm glad some of that reached you, even quietly, over the years.
Yusuf: Can I bring dinner this weekend, to make things right properly?
Father: You don't need to make anything right, but yes, I would enjoy that very much.
Yusuf: [relieved] Good. I love you, Dad, and I'm sorry again for yesterday.
Father: [warmly] I love you too, son. This call already means everything to me.

quiz.question: Why is Yusuf calling his father?
options: To apologize for being rude at dinner
quiz.explanation: Yusuf calls to apologize for raising his voice and being rude to his father at dinner.

quiz.explanation: The father forgives Yusuf and admits he made similar mistakes with his own father when young.

quiz.question: What does the father advise Yusuf to do next time he feels frustrated?
quiz.explanation: The father advises Yusuf to take a breath before speaking next time frustration rises.

quiz.question: What is the father’s tone during the call?
quiz.explanation: He listens, forgives Yusuf, and gives gentle advice.
